text:
Priya: Quick check — we need to lock scope for the console observability rollout (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Proposal: phased GA. Dashboards v1 + basic cost breakdown for GA, tracing hooks as opt-in beta, error analytics MVP (top errors/regressions) — pilot per-route cost with one customer. Thoughts?

Sanjay: +1 to phased. Dashboards+cost first. Tracing hooks bring infra risk if enabled by default. Who owns sampling & backpressure?

Elaine: From eng-infra: we can do tracing as a feature-flagged beta. Need ~2w to add sampling controls, a test harness, and a simple throttling layer.

Matt: SRE view — if tracing is opt-in we still need hard rate limits and an emergency off switch. Also want a clear retention policy for traces.

Priya: Draft launch criteria (high level):
- Dashboards+basic cost: render latency <300ms for common queries, cost attribution delta <5% vs batch, docs + quickstart.
- Tracing beta: feature-flagged, one internal service instrumented, sampling & throttling, rollover alert.
- Error analytics MVP: surface top 10 error types, regression alert on rate uplift >X%, easy drilldown to traces.

Lucy: :thumbsup: Customer ask — Acme wants per-route cost in GA. They're on Dedicated and say it's blocking their rollout.

Anil: Note: Per-route cost requires richer telemetry (route tags) and changes to exporter pipeline. Rough estimate: 3 sprints if we prioritize.

Sanjay: Tradeoff: If we fold per-route cost into GA, dashboards slip by ~2 sprints. Proposal: GA without per-route; run a pilot with Acme for per-route and share roadmap.

Priya: That sounds reasonable. Can we define pilot acceptance criteria so Acme can be onboarded quickly?

Sanjay: I'll draft acceptance criteria tonight. Initial thoughts: sample coverage >=95% for top 10 routes, cost variance <10% vs monthly exports, docs + demo runbook, no perf regression in control plane.

Matt: Add SRE constraint: tracing/control-plane changes must not exceed 2% CPU on the control plane under typical load.

Elaine: Rollout plan detail: tracing config exposed via API/console toggle per-environment. Example snippet for customers:```yaml
tracing:
  enabled: false
  sample_rate: 0.01
```
We'll gate the sample rate and provide a recommended default.

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: Mon 08:00 - Wed 20:00 next week for initial dashboard deploy.

Priya: Owners: Priya (PM), Sanjay (Eng lead), Elaine (Infra), Matt (SRE). Commitments: Dashboards + basic cost in 3w (canary next week), tracing beta gated in 5w, per-route cost pilot with Acme in 6w, error analytics MVP in 4w.

Lucy: Legal needs to sign off on trace retention for the pilot (retention + PII controls).

Anil: I'll ping Legal now and add the checklist to the pilot doc.

Priya: I'll update the public roadmap doc (tracking: https://go.redwood/roadmap/visibility) and create a short PRD with the acceptance criteria and owners. If no objections I'll mark this as the plan and schedule follow-ups.

Sanjay: No objections from Eng.

Matt: No objections from SRE.

Elaine: No objections from Infra, will post ETA for sampling work tomorrow.

Priya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the PRD + timeline. :sparkles:
